_comment: Corrections applied to the frozen catalog during import.
sources/ is hash-pinned and must never be edited: it is the record of what was
inherited, defects included. So a defect found in it is fixed HERE, at the import
boundary, where the change is a reviewable diff with its evidence attached.
Every entry below was produced by `npm run check:citations:online`, which reads
arXiv's own metadata. arXiv — not the PDF — is the authority for what a preprint
is called: an earlier audit compared against PDFs and reported a correction that
was not needed, because a paper can be retitled for camera-ready while its record
`from` is matched exactly before `to` is written. If the frozen value ever stops
matching, the import refuses rather than silently applying a stale correction.
knn-prompting      arXiv renders '$k$NN Prompting'; the catalog stripped the
LaTeX. A rendering difference, not an error.
skeleton-of-thought  the catalog cites the paper's original title, which matches
its stated venue of ICLR 2024. arXiv now shows the retitled
version. Stale, but correct for the venue cited.
